# v0.5.0 — Import, validate and repair

2026-09-09 (UTC) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/yyyz1011/sheetdelta/releases/tag/v0.5.0)

## Changes

Validated file-import workflows and complete API examples.

## Installation and upgrade

Install this version:

```sh
npm install sheetdelta-core@0.5.0
```

Review the [migration guide](../migration) and [related usage guide](../import-workflow) before upgrading. This is a summary of released changes, not a claim of support for every Excel feature.
